tool_args.rationale: The probe revealed a steep downturn above the pilot range, consistent with the recalled supercritical avalanche law. Fit its parameters numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither explains the observed sharp gradient-dependent collapse and negative high-gradient responses as directly as the avalanche mechanism.
The acquired high-gradient rows span the threshold and provide sufficient observations to fit the stated five-parameter mechanism.
